corrections.why: The register names the administrator as the Florida Forest Service - Punta Gorda Forestry Station. That is a Florida state forestry agency, not a federal one. Human check advised.

notes_for_editor: Single readable source: the NHLR detail page (cached). Unresolved conflicts, not in the story: (1) A Waymarking page (wm5GXN_Punta_Gorda_Lookout_Tower_PID_AD7808) cites a 1982 Florida DOT description of a steel tower about 110 feet high, about 8.5 miles southeast of Punta Gorda on the northeast side of US 41 northbound. That conflicts with NHLR's 100 ft and forestry-station siting. fetch_text could not read the page body (only the title was cached), so nothing from it is quoted; a human should check whether it is the same tower. (2) The record's news-press source (2017 Lee County fire-towers article) returns HTTP 403. A search snippet describes the Caloosahatchee Forestry Center tower in Lee County, so it is probably not a Punta Gorda source; not cited. (3) The Forest Lookouts Weebly index lists PUNTA GORDA under Glades County, but only in navigation text with no body, so it is not used. Not verified: construction date, builder, fire history, staffing, public access. The record's ownership 'federal' is contradicted by NHLR (correction proposed). No photos added; the record's NHLR photos are all rights reserved.
